interest: Provides granular South Manchuria Railway data on bean oil extraction technology, mill costs, and regional chemical manufacturing.
overview: This file contains U.S. consular despatches and State Department records from 1932 to 1936 documenting the soybean and chemical industries in Dairen and the Kwantung Leased Territory. It features an extensive 1936 South Manchuria Railway Company report on Manchurian bean oil extraction technologies, byproduct processing, mill construction costs, and trade statistics, alongside a 1932 memorandum examining local ammonium sulphate production capacity and markets.
